nodes.label: SF Chronicle 'presence' feature — extended Robert Nadeau interview (Jul 31, 1983, p.267)

metadata.note: Substantial feature: Nadeau described as 'one of its most creative teachers... a former policeman'; interviewed 'at Aikido of San Francisco'; Redwood City cop anecdotes; 'several years' study in Japan under Ueshiba; black-belt student Steve Gengo (psychiatric technician, McAuley Neuropsychiatric Institute, St. Mary's Hospital); 'the Bay area — where the art is most strongly established in the U.S.'

nodes.label: Herald-Sun conference program — Thorsen & Moon 'Aikido and Dialogue' (Oct 7, 1997)

metadata.note: 'For the past 20 years, their company, Performance Edge, has been consulting to many of our nations leading edge industries such as Apple, Federal Express, Ericsson and Cellular One. Dr. Meg Wheatley, last year's conference keynote speaker, uses Chris and Richard regularly in her Sundance workshops.' Interactive 'Aikido and Dialogue' session billed 'first-of-its-kind' for attendees.

metadata.note: Speaker program alongside 'Founder and Chairman Emeritus of VISA', 'Chris Turner: 4// Hat and No Cattle', '1998: Self Mastery & Leadership' (prior-year theme), 'Charlotte Roberts: The Dance of Change', 'Anson Dorrance: UNC Women's Soccer Head Coach'.
